skill.summary: Set up a basic coal forge using scrap and local materials, then learn the core hand techniques to repair farm tools, make simple hardware, and start earning...

latestVersion.changelog:
Village Blacksmith Starter 1.0.0

- Initial release providing a step-by-step guide to set up and operate a basic coal forge in a rural village, using local scrap and materials.
- Covers sourcing and assembling essential tools (forge, hammer, tongs, anvil) for under $80.
- Detailed daily instructions for learning core forging techniques: drawing out, upsetting, bending, punching, and twisting.
- Includes safety, fire control, and real-world advice for earning income or bartering through high-demand village repairs.
- Emphasizes practical, beginner-friendly rules and tips for sustainable village blacksmithing.
